assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome
The patient has established atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries

The service is medically necessary to document the patient's symptomatic cardiac arrhythmia burden
The service is medically necessary to guide appropriate clinical management of the underlying conduction and coronary pathology
